MAC OS Installation instructions:
Download powdr.app.zip file
Move program to folder you want to program to live (i.e. /Documents/powdR)
Double click to unzip
Right click on file and click "open terminal at folder"
Run the following command: xattr -cr powdR.app 
Close terminal
Double click to .app file to run
 
Windows Installation Instructions (.exe coming soon):
Install the python scripts in the source folder
Run the app_qt.py script (gui wrapper)
 
Use Instructions:
download the example_inputs folder
use the csv files as demo inputs
